title: Fix Internet Identity login reliability and ensure Q1 2027/Q1 2029 acquisition timers unlock with WhatsApp redirection

requirements.text: Fix the Internet Identity login/logout UX so users can reliably log in and log out without getting stuck in an inconsistent state (e.g., repeated clicks, "User is already authenticated" loop, requiring a hard refresh), without changing the app’s visual design.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking Login successfully authenticates and enables authenticated-gated pages without requiring a page refresh.
Clicking Logout clears the session and returns the UI to the logged-out state; subsequent Login works again.
No uncaught promise errors or console loops occur during login/logout interactions.
No edits are made to immutable files: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts and frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts.

requirements.text: Ensure the Acquisition Portal presale and airdrop countdown timers unlock at the correct UTC times for Q1 2027 (presale) and Q1 2029 (airdrop), and that the backend exposes correct remaining time values in nanoseconds.

quotes: make sure both forms pre-sale Q1 2027 AND Q1 2029 open at there time

acceptanceCriteria: backend/main.mo constants and/or timer state produce correct UTC-based nanosecond timestamps for Q1 2027 (presale) and Q1 2029 (airdrop).
backend/main.mo query methods getPresaleRemainingTime() and getAirdropRemainingTime() return 0 when the respective timer has passed, otherwise a positive nanosecond duration.
The airdrop timer value is in nanoseconds (same scale as Time.now()) and not an incorrectly small value due to unit mismatch.
No changes break existing timer APIs getTimerState(timerType) and toggleTimer(timerType).

requirements.text: Ensure both Acquisition Portal forms (Presale Registration and Airdrop Registration) redirect to WhatsApp for the configured direct number (+92 329 4238997) when unlocked, and that pending submissions saved before unlock automatically redirect once the countdown reaches zero, without changing the visual design.
acceptanceCriteria: When presale is unlocked, submitting the presale form opens WhatsApp using REDIRECT_CONFIG.whatsapp.directUrl (https://wa.me/923294238997) with the pre-filled message payload.
When airdrop is unlocked, submitting the airdrop form opens WhatsApp using REDIRECT_CONFIG.whatsapp.directUrl (https://wa.me/923294238997) with the pre-filled message payload.
If a user submits either form before unlock, the submission is saved and the app automatically redirects to WhatsApp after unlock (using the existing sessionStorage pending flow).
User-facing text remains in English and existing visual design (colors/typography/layout) is unchanged.

requirements.text: Complete any missing wiring required so authentication-gated pages that depend on backend permissions (via AccessControl) work consistently after login, including ensuring the actor initialization/access-control initialization path does not intermittently leave the app in an unauthenticated/unauthorized state after a successful Internet Identity login.

quotes: complete the whole coding and fix login issues

acceptanceCriteria: After a successful Internet Identity login, pages that require authentication (e.g., Market Intel, Live Price, Market Pulse, Voting) can load their data without spurious Unauthorized errors caused by an actor/identity mismatch.
Logging out clears cached authenticated queries and prevents authenticated endpoints from being called with a stale identity.
No visual design changes are introduced.

constraints: Preserve Version 89 UI visual design (no color, typography, layout changes).

Do not edit frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, and frontend/src/components/ui/* (compose instead).
Use English for all user-facing text.
Backend must remain single-actor (all Motoko logic in backend/main.mo); add backend/migration.mo only if an upgrade-safe state migration is required.
nonGoals: Implementing third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Changing the WhatsApp target number away from +92 329 4238997.
Redesigning the Acquisition Portal or other pages (visual refresh, new color palette, layout changes).
Adding unspecified new features/services beyond resolving login reliability and acquisition timer unlock/redirection behavior.
